title: No TODO marker in text files
description: Reports TODO markers in text files.
rationale: A retained marker usually means unfinished work and should be reviewed before submission.

todo-marker.message: This text file contains a TODO marker.
todo-marker.help: Resolve the TODO or document why it is intentionally retained.

limitations: Only checks eligible UTF-8 text files whose paths match the scope.
Does not infer whether a TODO is intentional.
